```{=html}
<script>
  // Keep the custom rail's active state in sync with Quarto's category filter.
  function mnSetCat(el) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.notes-catrail__item').forEach(function (x) {
      x.classList.remove('is-active');
    });
    if (el) el.classList.add('is-active');
  }
  (function () {
    function syncFromHash() {
      var m = location.hash.match(/category=([^&]*)/);
      var active = m ? decodeURIComponent(m[1]) : '';
      var match = document.querySelector('.notes-catrail__item[data-cat="' + (active || '') + '"]');
      if (match) mnSetCat(match);
    }
    window.addEventListener('load', syncFromHash);
    window.addEventListener('hashchange', syncFromHash);
  })();
  // Collapsible section indexes: jumping to a section (via the header chips
  // or a #hash link) opens its <details> so the list is visible on arrival.
  (function () {
    function openFromHash() {
      var id = (location.hash || '').slice(1);
      if (!id) return;
      var el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (el && el.tagName === 'DETAILS' && !el.open) el.open = true;
    }
    window.addEventListener('load', openFromHash);
    window.addEventListener('hashchange', openFromHash);
    openFromHash();
  })();
</script>
```
